description.en: Intended to check whether the whole team's TP gauges are maxed out — the TP counterpart to CMND_TEAM_GP_IS_MAX, with the same caveat about the per-member comparison not visibly affecting the returned value.
True on any valid call (the internal per-member comparison doesn't visibly affect the returned value in the decompiled code); null if the call was invalid or the roster data isn't ready.

example.code:
// Check whether the whole team's TP gauges are maxed out
local teamTpMaxed = CMND_TEAM_TP_IS_MAX();
